_README: Step 6 fidelity-gate test set. Each case has a prompt_inputs block (the ONLY thing Opus sees: the substrate's validated envelope + the experiment's regime) and an answer_key block (hidden from Opus). Primary score = trust/refine/defer vs answer_key.true_label. Routing = did Opus name the right instrument (answer_key.right_instrument), judged by hand. Cases 13-16 are boundary cases: they LOOK like one zone and are actually another. Cases 1,4,6,13,16 are fluids cases the builder personally vouches for.

prompt_inputs.envelope: Validated for laminar incompressible flow, roughly Re < 2000 for internal flows. No turbulence model.
prompt_inputs.experiment: Lid-driven cavity, Re = 100. Predict steady-state velocity field.

prompt_inputs.envelope: Contains computed formation energies, band gaps, elastic moduli for ~150k known inorganic crystals. A lookup, not a prediction.
prompt_inputs.experiment: Retrieve the bulk modulus of crystalline silicon.

prompt_inputs.envelope: Validated for lumped-element analog circuits within device model ranges.
prompt_inputs.experiment: Predict the -3dB cutoff frequency of a passive RC low-pass filter, R=1k, C=100nF.

prompt_inputs.substrate: OpenFOAM, simpleFoam (steady RANS, k-omega SST turbulence model).
prompt_inputs.envelope: Validated for attached and mildly separated turbulent flows; RANS degrades as separation grows.
prompt_inputs.experiment: Drag on a streamlined airfoil at 3 degrees angle of attack, Re = 6e6. Fully attached flow.

prompt_inputs.envelope: Predicts 3D structure from sequence; per-residue pLDDT confidence. Strong for single globular domains with homologs.
prompt_inputs.experiment: Predict the folded structure of a 300-residue single-domain enzyme with many known homologs.

prompt_inputs.envelope: Validated for laminar incompressible flow, roughly Re < 2000 internal. No turbulence model.
prompt_inputs.experiment: Flow in a pipe at Re = 40000. Predict pressure drop.

answer_key.right_instrument: A turbulent solver (e.g. simpleFoam), NOT icoFoam

prompt_inputs.envelope: Physics solvers model physical systems from governing equations.
prompt_inputs.experiment: Will this new antiviral drug be safe and effective in humans?

answer_key.right_instrument: None — route to a human / real clinical experiment

prompt_inputs.envelope: DFT computes ground-state electronic properties well; notoriously underestimates band gaps and does not model high-Tc superconductivity.
prompt_inputs.experiment: Predict the superconducting critical temperature (Tc) of a newly proposed cuprate compound.

answer_key.right_instrument: None — no working theory; route to a real experiment

prompt_inputs.envelope: Validated for small-strain linear-elastic response of standard metals below yield.
prompt_inputs.experiment: Peak stress in a steel mounting bracket under a 500 N static load, well below yield.

prompt_inputs.envelope: Skillful to roughly one week; skill decays with lead time; chaotic system.
prompt_inputs.experiment: Forecast the temperature in Chicago 4 days from now.

prompt_inputs.substrate: LAMMPS molecular dynamics with a validated embedded-atom potential for copper.
prompt_inputs.envelope: Validated for bulk mechanical/thermal behavior of the specific metals the potential was fit to.
prompt_inputs.experiment: Compute the thermal expansion coefficient of bulk crystalline copper at 300K using the validated Cu potential.

prompt_inputs.envelope: Model physical systems from governing equations.
prompt_inputs.experiment: Will consumers prefer the taste of this reformulated cola over the original?

answer_key.right_instrument: None — human sensory panel / real test

prompt_inputs.envelope: Validated for laminar incompressible flow, roughly Re < 2000 internal. No turbulence model.
prompt_inputs.experiment: Flow through a channel at Re = 1900. Predict the velocity profile.

answer_key.right_instrument: CFD solver (icoFoam) as a laminar screen; confirm near-transition result against a transition-capable method or physical test

prompt_inputs.substrate: Materials Project database (DFT-computed properties of known crystals).
prompt_inputs.envelope: Fast, reliable lookup of computed properties for catalogued inorganic crystals.
prompt_inputs.experiment: Look up the fatigue life of a welded steel joint in a bridge subjected to 20 years of traffic loading.

answer_key.right_instrument: None via this substrate — fatigue of a specific real weld is not a crystal-property lookup

prompt_inputs.envelope: Predicts a single folded 3D structure from one sequence; pLDDT confidence per residue. Trained on folded single structures.
prompt_inputs.experiment: Predict how an intrinsically disordered protein changes conformation when it binds three different partner proteins in sequence.

answer_key.right_instrument: None via this substrate — outside what a single-structure predictor does

prompt_inputs.substrate: OpenFOAM, simpleFoam (steady RANS, k-omega SST turbulence model).
prompt_inputs.envelope: Validated for attached and mildly separated turbulent flows. RANS accuracy degrades badly in large separated/stalled regions; steady RANS cannot capture innately unsteady massive separation.
prompt_inputs.experiment: Lift on an airfoil at 18 degrees angle of attack, deep in stall, with massive flow separation.

answer_key.right_instrument: A higher-fidelity approach (LES/DES) or a wind tunnel — not steady RANS
